preconditions: The exact accepted Core and control wheels are already staged in .syncmate/package-inputs with the committed filenames and digests. Clean landed canonical main is required. Probe all physical node queues through each reachable endpoint; unknown/busy state blocks. Connection refusal/timeouts before a remote response may be deferred; authentication/configuration/package failures may not. Do not stop active jobs or migrate queues.
readBack: Read the returned prepared result: at least one node and the controller must verify the exact pinned runtime payloads. Deferred nodes remain pending, never verified. Immutable runtimes and .syncmate/deployments/<source-sha> manifests/wheels are persistent product inputs, including for a returning node. Base interpreters and their installed packages remain unchanged. Incomplete runtime prefixes are preserved for explicit diagnosis. Closeout archives necessary console evidence and removes only the exclusive .syncmate/package-inputs copies after all staged wheel digests are verified; do not remove the deployment wheels or ready runtimes. No GPU job is launched.
